name: SOAP Note Buddy
description: SOAP Note Buddy is a Chrome extension AI scribe starting at $29/month for 40 notes, with unlimited plans also from $29/mo. Installs in seconds and works with any browser-based EMR through intelligent field detection—no integrations required. Supports SOAP, DAP, BIRP, GIRP, PIE, and EMDR note formats. Voice scribe for ambient documentation and dictation. Key differentiator: automatic PHI scrubbing happens locally in your browser before data leaves device—names, DOB, addresses, SSN removed automatically. HIPAA compliant with BAA available. Originally designed for PT/OT/SLP but supports mental health documentation. Best for rehab therapists (PT/OT/SLP) and clinicians wanting a simple browser-based solution. Mental health therapists may prefer Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo) for therapy-specific features.

faqs.q: How much does SOAP Note Buddy cost in 2026?
faqs.a: SOAP Note Buddy starts at $29/month for 40 notes (Starter plan). Unlimited plans are also available from $29/month. Costs less than $2/day with no IT setup required.

faqs.q: Does SOAP Note Buddy work with my EHR?
faqs.a: Yes—SOAP Note Buddy works with any browser-based EMR through intelligent field detection. No specific integrations needed. It automatically recognizes and fills EHR fields. Desktop-only EHRs not supported.

faqs.q: Is SOAP Note Buddy HIPAA compliant?
faqs.a: Yes. SOAP Note Buddy is HIPAA compliant with BAA available. Key feature: automatic PHI scrubbing removes names, DOB, SSN, and addresses before data leaves your device. Data stays in browser's secure local storage.

faqs.q: Is SOAP Note Buddy good for mental health therapists?
faqs.a: SOAP Note Buddy supports mental health formats (SOAP, DAP, BIRP, EMDR) but is primarily designed for PT/OT/SLP. Mental health therapists may prefer purpose-built tools like Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo) for therapy-specific features.

faqs.q: SOAP Note Buddy vs Mentalyc: which is better for therapy?
faqs.a: Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) is purpose-built for mental health with modality-aware templates (CBT/DBT/IFS) and therapy-specific features. SOAP Note Buddy ($29/mo) is better for PT/OT/SLP and rehab disciplines. For therapy, choose Mentalyc.
